description: Search tasks and steps by text in the title or description (case-insensitive, up to 100 tasks scanned). Returns matching lines grouped by status, with ids (a step names the task it belongs to), or a line saying nothing matched.

project.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server"). Matched case-insensitively (or a project id). An unknown name matches nothing.

project_id.description: Filter by project id (project, a name, is easier)

name: taskhold_search
title: Search tasks
